strings.d1.s0.name: Red Square
strings.d1.s0.tips: Come in the morning when the square is empty. Take in St. Basil's and the GUM façades, and Lenin's Mausoleum (Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, 10:00-13:00).
strings.d1.s1.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
strings.d1.s1.tips: Onion-domed cathedral with narrow interior staircases and icons.
strings.d1.s2.name: Moscow Kremlin & Armoury
strings.d1.s2.tips: Kremlin cathedrals plus the Armoury (Fabergé eggs). Book online 2 weeks ahead. Closed Thursday; Armoury entry is timed.
strings.d1.s3.name: GUM Gastronom No.1
strings.d1.s3.tips: GUM's Soviet-themed food hall, with ice cream (plombir) and a cafeteria.
strings.d1.s4.name: Zaryadye Park Floating Bridge
strings.d1.s4.tips: Modern park beside the Kremlin, with a bridge over the river and an ice cave. Best at sunset.
strings.d1.b0.name: Stolovaya 57 GUM
strings.d1.b1.name: State Historical Museum
strings.d1.b1.tips: The red museum on Red Square. A good option if you have no Kremlin ticket.
strings.d2.s0.name: Tretyakov Gallery
strings.d2.s0.tips: Russian painting: Repin, Vrubel and icons (Rublev's Trinity). Closed Monday.
strings.d2.s1.name: Zamoskvorechye Streets
strings.d2.s1.tips: Old merchant district, with Pyatnitskaya Street and its churches.
strings.d2.s2.name: Lepim i Varim Pyatnitskaya
strings.d2.s2.tips: Handmade pelmeni (dumplings) with a range of fillings.
strings.d2.s3.name: Muzeon Park & Krymskaya Naberezhnaya
strings.d2.s3.tips: Soviet sculpture park (including the toppled Dzerzhinsky) and the riverside promenade.
strings.d2.s4.name: Gorky Park
strings.d2.s4.tips: Moscow's main park: cycling and dancing in summer, and Europe's largest ice rink in winter.
strings.d2.b0.name: Cafe Pushkin
strings.d2.b0.tips: Aristocratic Russian cuisine on Tverskoy. Book ahead.
strings.d2.b1.name: Garage Museum of Contemporary Art
strings.d2.b1.tips: Contemporary art in Gorky Park, in a building by Rem Koolhaas.
strings.d3.s0.name: Komsomolskaya Metro Station
strings.d3.s0.tips: Baroque station with mosaics. Start your metro tour here (with a Troika card).
strings.d3.s1.name: Mayakovskaya Metro Station
strings.d3.s1.tips: Art deco steel arches and ceiling mosaics.
strings.d3.s2.name: Ploshchad Revolyutsii Metro
strings.d3.s2.tips: Bronze statues. Rub the dog's nose.
strings.d3.s3.name: Arbat Street
strings.d3.s3.tips: Pedestrian street with matryoshka dolls, street musicians and Pushkin's house.
strings.d3.s4.name: Mari Vanna Moscow
strings.d3.s4.tips: Russian cuisine in a grandmother's-house setting: borscht and pelmeni.
strings.d3.b0.name: Varenichnaya No.1 Arbat
strings.d3.b1.name: Pushkin Museum of Fine Arts
strings.d3.b1.tips: Impressionists and Egyptian collections. An alternative to Arbat.
strings.d4.s0.name: VDNKh
strings.d4.s0.tips: Soviet exhibition of achievements. See the Friendship of Nations fountain and the Kosmos pavilion (paid museum); the grounds are free.
strings.d4.s1.name: Museum of Cosmonautics
strings.d4.s1.tips: Beneath the Monument to the Conquerors of Space, with Gagarin and Sputnik.
strings.d4.s2.name: VDNKh Pavilion Cafeteria
strings.d4.s2.tips: Soviet-style stolovaya (canteen) inside the exhibition grounds, serving shashlik.
strings.d4.s3.name: Ostankino Tower
strings.d4.s3.tips: 540 m tower. Bring your passport; glass floor, timed entry.
strings.d4.b0.name: Moskovskoye Nebo VDNKh
strings.d4.b1.name: Botanical Garden VDNKh
strings.d4.b1.tips: Botanical garden next to the exhibition grounds. An alternative to the tower.
strings.d5.s0.name: Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour by train from Yaroslavsky Station. The centre of Russian Orthodoxy, with blue and gold domes and the shrine of St. Sergius. Bring a headscarf.
strings.d5.s1.name: Lavra Trapeznaya Dining Hall
strings.d5.s1.tips: Monastery refectory serving fish and kvass.
strings.d5.s2.name: Sergiev Posad Toy Museum
strings.d5.s2.tips: The birthplace of the matryoshka, with wooden toys.
strings.d5.s3.name: Blinnaya Gora Viewpoint
strings.d5.s3.tips: Postcard view of the monastery from a hilltop.
strings.d5.b0.name: Gostevaya Izba Sergiev Posad
strings.d5.b0.tips: Lunch in a traditional Russian izba (log house).
strings.d5.b1.name: Abramtsevo Estate
strings.d5.b1.tips: Artists' colony estate. An alternative to the museum, on the way.
strings.d6.s0.name: Kolomenskoye
strings.d6.s0.tips: Riverside tsarist estate with the Church of the Ascension (UNESCO), a replica wooden palace and apple orchards.
strings.d6.s1.name: Kolomenskoye Tea House
strings.d6.s1.tips: Samovar tea and blini in the park.
strings.d6.s2.name: Moscow City Federation Tower Panorama 360
strings.d6.s2.tips: Observation deck on the 89th floor, with free ice cream and views over the skyscraper district.
strings.d6.s3.name: Khachapuri Restaurant Bolshaya Gruzinskaya
strings.d6.s3.tips: Georgian chain serving khachapuri (cheese bread) and khinkali (dumplings), a Moscow favourite.
strings.d6.s4.name: Patriarch's Ponds
strings.d6.s4.tips: Bulgakov's pond, with cafés and an evening stroll.
strings.d6.b0.name: Sakhli Georgian Restaurant
strings.d6.b1.name: Novodevichy Convent
strings.d6.b1.tips: Red-walled convent and cemetery of famous figures. An alternative to the skyscrapers.
strings.d7.s0.name: Bolshoi Theatre
strings.d7.s0.tips: Façade and square. Performance tickets sell out months ahead; photograph it in the morning.
strings.d7.s1.name: Eliseevsky / Tverskaya
strings.d7.s1.tips: Tverskaya Street for coffee and souvenirs (Christmas atmosphere in winter).
strings.d7.s2.name: Cafe Pushkin Konditerskaya
strings.d7.s2.tips: Pushkin's pastry shop: cake and coffee for a farewell treat.
strings.d7.s3.name: Aeroexpress Belorussky
strings.d7.s3.tips: Aeroexpress to Sheremetyevo takes 35 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Dr. Zhivago Restaurant
strings.d7.b0.tips: Stylish Soviet-style breakfast at the National Hotel.
strings.d7.b1.name: Bunker-42
strings.d7.b1.tips: Cold War bunker tour. An alternative to the Bolshoi.
strings.note0: Use a Troika card for the metro (some of the world's most beautiful stations, worth a tour in themselves) and Yandex Go for taxis. Aeroexpress serves the airports.
strings.note1: Visa: Turkish citizens can stay 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Foreign bank cards do not work (2026), so carry cash roubles or a MIR card. Google Pay is unavailable.
strings.note2: Summer brings 22-28°C and light until 22:00: perfect for parks, river boats and cycling in Gorky Park.
strings.note3: Pelmeni cost 400-600 RUB, a Georgian restaurant 1,500-2,500 and a stolovaya 300. Tip 10%.
strings.note4: Book the Kremlin and Armoury online 2 weeks ahead. Lenin's Mausoleum opens Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings, with a 30-minute queue.
strings.note5: In churches, women should cover their heads and men remove their hats. Photography may be banned inside.
strings.transit.name: Troika Card
strings.transit.why_chosen: Covers the metro, buses and trams. Moscow's metro stations are among the most beautiful in the world.
